cs.t: I've used a Unicomp "Spacesaver" for many years and have been very happy with it. Recently I've switched to a ten-key-less keyboard with blue Cherry switches in order to have more space on the desk, and I've got to say that I much prefer the snappy feel of Cherry switches.
cs.th: PC-Retro Motherboard Kit: Build a faithful reproduction of the 1982 IBM PC 5150
